title: Export portable view state and render reports as text
summary: Keep diagram data independent from DOM references and HTML presentation.
objectives: Preserve supported graph and viewport fields in a synthetic round trip.
Render untrusted report content without treating it as HTML.

sources.title: Text rendering and textContent
sources.basis: Distinguishes text content from interpreted markup; the exercise is restricted to text-node output.

sections.title: Choose an explicit export contract
paragraphs: A synthetic view contains node IDs, optional parent IDs, edges and a viewport. Export data rather than browser elements or application secrets.
A real importer must validate supported fields, identifiers, sizes and nesting. A JSON round trip alone is not an importer or compatibility promise.

sections.title: Separate editing, theme and reporting evidence
paragraphs: A label editor needs selection, cancel and keyboard/focus tests; palette similarity alone does not establish accessible light and dark states.
The exercise escapes report text for an HTML text node. PDF output, URL attributes, styles, rich HTML and complete report automation need different contracts and tests.

exercise.instruction: Run the selected-knowledge exercises with pnpm test.
exercise.expected: Assert the documented result and its negative boundary; no external operation is performed.

limitations: The round trip is synthetic data only. Text-node escaping is not a general HTML sanitizer, accessibility audit, graph editor or PDF implementation.
